title: Senior , Tax Services -Global Trade Service + ABAP - Hyderabad, Gurugram ,Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business\-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever\-changing global environment with fast\-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
   

  

 We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi\-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought\-after career option.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work You'll Do \- Intro: Our team specializes in effective technology\-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day\-to\-day business operations.
   

  

 Work You'll Do \-:
   

  

* Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather and document detailed business requirements for GTS projects.
* In your role, you will lead and/or facilitate business process definition and modeling.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration.
* Coordinate with project teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within SAP GTS solutions.
* You will guide a team to implement and configure the software to replicate the required business processes and analytical/reporting needs.
* Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end\-users and client teams.
* Ensure that SAP GTS solutions comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including development, infrastructure, and business teams, to ensure seamless service delivery and support.
* You will contribute to the development and growth of the SAP GTS practice globally.


 The Team:
   

  

 The GTA practice is composed of operations specialists, Global Trade Management technology specialists, customs brokers, auditors, and trade management professionals who help importers and exporters achieve worldwide compliance and realize efficiencies and advantages in their global supply chain. You will be based in India and support Deloitte Tax to serve clients with international operations and supports their global trade compliance requirements.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 11 AM to 8 PM
   

  

**Qualifications \- Required:**
* Bachelor / Master degree in relation to Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or similar
* Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP GTS project implementation, and thus have significant knowledge of the SAP GTS Solution, in one of the following domains: Compliance Management, Customs Management, Trade Preference
* Good understanding of supply chain management processes
* Ability to travel up to 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Experience in other SAP modules than SAP GTS is an asset
* Technical knowledge (e.g. ABAP, SAP PI) is an asset
* Good analytical and modeling skills
* Team player with strong communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication in English
* Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires professionals to co\-locate in person 2\-3 days per week


 Qualifications \- Preferred:
   

  

* Education with SAP focus (S/4 or ECC Sales and Distribution, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Material Master, Transportation Management)
* Software aptitude in PowerPoint, MS Project, Access, Excel, and/or Visio
* Experience presenting to clients or other decision makers
* Knowledge of export regulations including ITAR/EAR
* Demonstrated interest in international trade or international business
* Strong research, writing, verbal communication, and project management skills
* Ability to bring out\-of\-the\-box solution design aligned to leading practices and differentiated business outcome
* Understanding of end\-to\-end processes and attention to detailed design
* Strong team and organizational skills, ability to self\-manage time and tasks
* Ability to manage client and cross functional team expectations


 \#TAXGTS
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Jr. MEP Project Manager
description:
Company Description
 



 BuildMyInfra (BMI) specializes in end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions for warehouses and retail stores, covering audit, design, supply, build, and monitoring services. The company delivers turnkey projects and acts as a procurement partner, with expertise spanning Civil, MEP, HVAC, Electrical, Fire Security, CCTV \& Surveillance, IT Networking, IT Managed Services, Office Interiors, IDS, FAS, and ACS. With in\-house resident engineers across PAN India and the Subcontinent (including Nepal), BMI focuses on completing projects on time while maintaining strong quality and industry standards. As a one\-stop solution, BMI reduces the need for multiple vendors and partners with leading e\-commerce and logistics companies throughout India.
 



**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site Project Manager – MEP role based in Gurugram. The Project Manager – MEP oversees planning, execution, and delivery of MEP works for warehouse and retail infrastructure projects, ensuring compliance with design, safety, and quality standards.
 



 Daily responsibilities
 



 include coordinating with clients, internal teams, and vendors; monitoring project schedules and budgets; and supervising site activities to ensure timely completion of MEP installations. The role involves managing procurement and expediting of MEP materials, conducting inspections, resolving technical issues, and preparing regular progress reports. The Project Manager also supports risk management, ensures adherence to regulatory requirements, and drives continuous improvement in project processes and outcomes.
 



**Qualifications** 




 Candidates should possess strong project management skills, including Project Management and experience overseeing MEP scopes.Candidates should possess skills in Expeditor and Expediting to manage timely delivery of materials and services.Candidates should possess Inspection skills to review MEP work quality and compliance with standards and drawings.Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to coordinate material movement, vendor schedules, and site requirements.Relevant degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering, or related field.
 


* Prior experience managing MEP projects in industrial, warehouse, or commercial infrastructure environments.
* Working knowledge of MEP design, installation practices, safety regulations, and applicable codes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving abilities, with proficiency in MS Office and project tracking tools.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, manage multiple projects, and travel to project locations as required.

title: Sr Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 Individual is responsible for overall program governance, working closely with the General Program Manager (BGDM) to drive day\-to\-day program execution. The role supports executive\-level reporting by providing clear project status updates, highlighting key risks, critical milestones, strategic priorities, and KPI performance to ensure delivery within schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
   

  

 This position is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and consolidating critical program data to support timely preventive and corrective actions, enabling effective decision\-making and continuous program improvement.
   

  

 The Program Office Manager also contributes to overall program success by ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, achieving financial targets, maintaining health and safety compliance, and driving operational service delivery excellence.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Program Governance \& Compliance: Ensure program execution aligns with governance standards, Nokia MoO, PM@Nokia methodology, and organizational guidelines.
* Program Planning \& Execution Support: Partner with the General Program Manager (BGDM) to drive day\-to\-day operations, delivery milestones, and successful program execution.
* Stakeholder \& Customer Management: Maintain proactive communication with customers and stakeholders, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and identification of growth opportunities.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reporting: Track KPIs, program progress, risks, financial performance, and provide regular executive updates to support informed decision\-making.
* Financial \& Risk Management: Monitor budget, scope, profitability, and risk exposure while driving corrective actions to protect margins and improve program outcomes.
* Operational Excellence \& Service Delivery: Ensure effective delivery of operational services, process adherence, seamless phase transitions (Sell\-to\-Execute and Delivery\-to\-Care), and continuous improvement through lessons learned.
* Documentation, Information Security \& Process Management: Manage program documentation, repositories, access controls, and ensure compliance with Nokia information security requirements.
* Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Coordination: Lead project teams and collaborate across functions such as operations, supply chain, logistics, and network delivery to achieve program objectives and business goals.


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Industry \& Domain Experience: Minimum 15 years of experience in Optical Networks, preferably with strong exposure to Subsea Cable Systems and technologies.
* Program \& Project Leadership: Minimum 10 years of Program/Project Management experience leading large, complex customer delivery programs.
* Subsea Project Expertise: Proven experience delivering subsea projects for global customers, carriers, consortiums, or enterprise clients.
* Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of the subsea domain, optical transport technologies, network deployment, and operational processes.
* Customer\-Facing Leadership: Demonstrated experience in customer\-facing roles, such as Project Manager or Technical Manager, managing stakeholder relationships and customer expectations.
* Governance, Risk \& Financial Management: Expertise in program governance, budget management, financial reporting, risk mitigation, KPI tracking, and compliance with industry standards and methodologies.
* Strategic Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent communication, executive reporting, presentation, conflict resolution, and cross\-functional collaboration skills to drive program success.
* Qualifications \& Compliance: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.Tech or equivalent) with PMP certification preferred; commitment to Nokia PM practices, Information Security (ISO 27001\), Health \& Safety, and continuous improvement principles.

title: SAP Configuration Delivery Lead-Project Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager**
**Job Title:**
 SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide executive\-level delivery leadership for global SAP transformation programs from planning through deployment and steady\-state support.
* Own delivery governance for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, RISE, testing, release management, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across business, functional, technical, application support, infrastructure, and third\-party teams to protect delivery quality and business continuity.


**Key responsibilities include:**
**Project \& Program Management**
* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**
* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.


**Business Process \& Solution Design**
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**
* Be a thought leader on data migration strategy and execution for master and transactional data.
* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**
* Engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.
* Mentor consultants and develop effective project teams through clear direction, knowledge sharing, and delivery discipline.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires sound judgment across delivery scope, schedule, budget, risk, testing, cutover, data migration, integration, and stakeholder decisions. The candidate will evaluate cross\-functional trade\-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and resolve issues in a global, matrixed SAP environment while protecting release quality, service stability, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Strong command of SAP delivery methods, governance routines, risk controls, testing models, release practices, and global rollout execution.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full\-cycle SAP implementations, migrations, production cutovers, and global rollouts.
* Experience leading SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE delivery across testing, release governance, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.
   

  

* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.
* Flexible work arrangements: EY flexible work policies are designed to support balance, trust, and autonomy, subject to business and role requirements.
* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.
* Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential performance\-based incentives.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Review Manager - India
description:
Your Impact
   

  

 Associate Review Managers work side\-by\-side with clients and our team of attorneys to leverage DISCO AI for the purpose of document review. They provide insight and perspective to improve client outcomes and increase the speed and quality of their eDiscovery experience. They create the optimal alignment of features and workflows within the context of case\-specific constraints, including leveraging well\-established best practices, to drive exceptional outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Project Management: Acts as the point of contact for clients during DISCO Managed Review projects. Manages teams of reviewers and provides necessary feedback and guidance to ensure speed and accuracy. Manages fast\-moving and complex projects. Adapts work schedule to support global client engagements in various time zones (primarily in the USA and UK).
* Review Process Design and Quality Control: Implements review workflows, including QC workflows, based on the needs of individual review projects. Optimizes and tailors managed review workflows based on project need. Designs review and quality control workflows and carries out some QC responsibilities. Implements custom workflows in conjunction with our AI lab to reduce client costs and enhance speed\-to\-evidence for clients.
* Training and Development: Guides the team and mentors new Team Leads, QC personnel, and first\-line reviewers. Fosters a strong, inclusive team environment and culture, where questions are encouraged and diversity is celebrated.
* Documentation and Reporting: Creates and refines DISCO standard documentation, including review protocols, status reports, training guides and review workflows. Reports on key project metrics to the broader Review team. Actively tracks and suggests improvements on operational parameters (including cost, efficiency, and quality metrics).
* Client Interaction and Feedback Integration: Works closely with clients to understand how cutting\-edge tech is applied to document review to achieve exceptional review results. Collaborates closely with product and engineering teams by providing feedback and feature requests. Showcases excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Who You Are**
* 5\+ years of document review management experience at an eDiscovery / managed review or alternative legal services provider, in\-house e\-discovery review function, or consulting firm
* Strong understanding of AI capabilities and applications
* Skilled at the use of at least one industry\-leading review platform, like DISCO, Relativity, Everlaw, Axcelerate, etc.


**Perks of DISCO**
* Open, inclusive, and fun environment
* Benefits, including medical and dental insurance
* Competitive salary plus discretionary bonus
* Opportunity to be a part of a startup that is revolutionizing the legal industry
* Growth opportunities throughout the company


**About DISCO**
 DISCO provides a cloud\-native, artificial intelligence\-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters.
   

  

 At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.
   

  

 Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us!
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Specialist, Customer Project Planning
description:
Join our project delivery team as a Customer Project Planning Specialist. This role puts you at the center of project execution, where you'll manage schedules, coordinate with customers, and ensure every project delivers on its promise.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Oversee project schedules from start to finish, ensuring on\-time delivery and exceptional customer satisfaction
* Act as the scheduling focal point for your region, coordinating between customers and internal teams
* Manage contracts strategically to protect company interests while nurturing customer partnerships
* Provide consultancy and conduct quality audits to maintain high standards across all project activities


**What are the key skills we are looking for?**
* Scheduling — advanced level; managing complex project timelines across multiple stakeholders and regions
* Resource Planning — intermediate level; allocating resources effectively to meet project demands
* Resource Allocation — intermediate level; optimizing team capacity to deliver on commitments
* Data Analysis and Interpretation — intermediate level; analyzing project metrics to identify risks and opportunities
* Customer Orientation — developing level; building relationships that balance customer needs with business objectives
* Risk Management — developing level; identifying and mitigating project risks before they impact delivery
* Project Management — developing level; coordinating activities to ensure projects stay on scope and schedule
* Contract Management — developing level; overseeing agreements to protect company interests and ensure compliance


**What qualifications will make you successful?**
* Exceptional organizational abilities with a talent for juggling multiple projects and priorities
* Strong communication skills that build trust and influence across all organizational levels
* Forward\-thinking approach that spots potential issues and solves them proactively
* Team\-oriented mindset with a passion for mentoring and developing others


**What's in it for me?**

* Supportive team culture that respects your professional judgment and autonomy

 Bring your planning expertise to a team that values precision and impact — apply now!

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
 At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
   

  

**Information About The Business**
**Aon's human capital** 
 business provides leaders with a powerful mix of data, analytics, and advice to help them make better workforce decisions. Aon's human capital business, spanning 2,000 colleagues in more than 30 countries, is home to the firm's rewards, talent assessment, and performance \& analytics practices. We apply this expertise, and our market\-leading workforce data, to help clients tackle transformational projects.
   

  

**General Description Of Role**
 This role is responsible for leading and developing a high\-performing team, providing operational oversight, stakeholder management, and delivery governance for client due diligence questionnaire support activities. The individual will be accountable for team performance, service delivery, process excellence, and ensuring a high\-quality stakeholder experience in a fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder environment.
   

  

 The role supports the end\-to\-end management of client due diligence questionnaires across the organization, including intake, coordination with subject matter experts, response consolidation, stakeholder communication, and timely delivery of completed submissions. Success in this role requires strong leadership, ownership, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to drive outcomes through influence and effective coordination.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 The colleague is responsible for leading a team that provides high\-quality operational support to internal and external stakeholders, ensuring effective delivery, stakeholder satisfaction, and adherence to service, quality, and governance standards through the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Drive accountability for team deliverables, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance requirements.
* Manage centralized intake and workflow processes, managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination, tracking, and timely execution across multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
* Minimum 2\-3 years of people management experience, including performance management, coaching, and team development.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders and effectively manage stakeholder expectations, communications, and escalations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cross\-functional teams including Privacy, Compliance, Security, ESG, Legal, and business partners.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies and influence stakeholders to drive timely outcomes in a matrixed environment.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team by providing regular feedback, guidance, and development opportunities.
* Monitor workload distribution, prioritize requests, remove operational bottlenecks, and proactively mitigate delivery risks.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and stakeholder experience.
* Analyze operational metrics, prepare management reports, and provide insights on volumes, turnaround times, SLA adherence, and team performance.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Preferred knowledge of governance, risk, compliance, privacy, security, ESG, or related business functions.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on delivering high\-quality outcomes and exceptional stakeholder experience.
* Preferred experience in handling a team of 15\-20
* Collaborate with peers at Aon to deliver high quality work and enhance personal effectiveness through training, education and coaching.


**Skills**
* Any Graduate
* No Technical Graduate (B.E/B.Tech) and No Regular Postgraduate (MBA/MCA/MA/M.Sc/M.Tech)
* Strong time management skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* High proficiency in project management and client service
* Advanced business communication skills (email and conference calls) and interpersonal abilities. Should be able to communicate thoughts and ideas verbally coherently and confidently, non‐verbally and in writing.
* Should be flexible, keen on taking initiatives, accountable, have a collaborative approach with fellow colleagues, self‐ motivator, and leadership qualities.
* Quality orientation and eye for details

title: Programs & Partnerships Manager
description:
**About myNachiketa** 




  






 myNachiketa is the world’s only D2C brand with products that bring the knowledge of the Gita \& Vedas to children. We design innovative products in the form of books, games, videos, workshops, learning programs and more.
 




  






 Our products are based on deep scholarship, with a special focus on ease of use and customer delight. We reach families through our books, digital platforms and programs in India and internationally.
 





 Our products have consistently received 4\.6\+ star ratings on Amazon and have featured as Bestsellers. We have reached over 500K families and have a growing community of parents, children and supporters.
 





 myNachiketa is founded by Varun Aggarwal, co\-founder of Aspiring Minds, which had a $100M exit. We work with a small, high\-performance team with the ambition to take Indian philosophical knowledge to children across the world.
 




  






 Website:
 
 www.mynachiketa.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are looking for a
 
**smart, enterprising and execution\-oriented individual** 

 who takes ownership early in their career and works directly with the founder on some of myNachiketa’s most important initiatives.
 





 This is a broad role, where you will work across
 
**program management, marketing, partnerships, community building and fundraising outreach** 

 , while independently owning key projects from planning to execution.
 





 One day you may be improving the Gita Scholar Program. The next, you could be identifying podcasts for founder outreach, building a donor pipeline, planning a workshop, or working on a campaign to grow participation in our programs.
 





 For the right person, this role can grow significantly in scope and responsibility. Responsibilities include: 
 




  





**Own our Programs** 



* Manage and improve the
 
**Gita Scholar Program, Gita Classes, workshops and other learning initiatives** 

 .
* Coordinate with parents, students, schools and partners to ensure programs run smoothly.
* Think beyond execution: identify ways to
 
**increase participation, engagement and impact** 

 .
* Track key metrics and continuously improve how our programs operate.



  





**Build Partnerships** 



* Identify and reach out to
 
**schools, communities, institutions and organizations** 

 that can help expand myNachiketa’s reach.
* Create structured outreach plans and follow through until closure. Build relationships with potential collaborators and partners.
* Research and build databases of
 
**individual donors, foundations, CSR organizations and other potential supporters** 

 .
* Support fundraising outreach, communication and follow\-ups.
* Work directly with the founder on developing relationships with potential supporters and ecosystem partners.



  





**Marketing \& Outreach** 



* Work on outreach initiatives across
 
**LinkedIn, email, podcasts, events and other channels** 

 .
* Identify relevant podcasts, media opportunities, events and forums for myNachiketa and its founders.
* Help conceptualize campaigns to grow awareness, participation and community engagement.
* Work with content and design teams to take campaigns from idea to execution.



  





**What are we looking for** 




  




* **1\.5\+ years of professional experience OR an MBA equivalent postgraduate management degree. Fresh MBAs may apply.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational ability and attention to detail.
* High ownership and a bias towards getting things done.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
* Strong research and analytical ability.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, digital tools and AI.
* Curious and willing to work across functions rather than remain within a narrow job description.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Prior experience in startups, education, program management, marketing, partnerships, community building or fundraising is a plus.
* An interest in education, Indian philosophy or social impact is useful, but
 
**ability, curiosity and ownership matter more** 

 .



  





**What is in it for you** 




  






 This role is designed for someone who wants
 
**breadth, ownership and rapid learning** 

 early in their career.
 





 You will:
 



* **Work directly with the founder** 

 and get exposure to how decisions are made and initiatives are built.
* Get hands\-on experience across
 
**program management, marketing, partnerships, fundraising and community building** 

 .
* Own meaningful projects rather than only supporting senior team members.
* Have the freedom to experiment, propose ideas and build new initiatives.
* See the direct impact of your work on customers, students, partners and the organization.
* Have the opportunity to take on significantly larger responsibilities as myNachiketa grows.




 For someone who performs well, this role can evolve into owning major programs, partnerships, or growth initiatives.
 




  






 Location: Gurugram
 





 Employment Type: Full\-time, work from office
 





 Experience: 1\.5\+ years professional experience OR MBA/equivalent

title: Design Team Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 AirBrick is transforming commercial interior design by combining human creativity with advanced artificial intelligence. The company’s multidisciplinary team of interior designers, architects, and AI specialists uses machine learning, data analytics, and computer vision to create functional, aesthetically aligned spaces that enhance productivity, employee satisfaction, and customer experience. AirBrick delivers interactive 3D visualizations, virtual reality walkthroughs, and real\-time design modifications so clients can make confident decisions before implementation. Serving industries such as corporate offices, coworking, hospitality, retail, and healthcare, AirBrick offers scalable, adaptable solutions for projects of varying size and complexity. The organization is focused on creating environments that reflect each client’s brand identity while improving workflow efficiency and space utilization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Design Team Lead is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram. This role oversees a multidisciplinary design team, guiding the end\-to\-end design process from initial client briefing and concept development through detailed design, review, and delivery. The Design Team Lead will coordinate closely with clients to understand business objectives, translate requirements into design solutions, and present design proposals using AirBrick’s AI\-enabled tools. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing project timelines and resources, aligning design output with brand and functional goals, reviewing and refining team members’ work, and collaborating with AI and product teams to incorporate data\-driven insights into design decisions. The role also involves mentoring team members, implementing best practices, and ensuring consistent quality across all commercial interior design projects.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Team Leadership and Team Management skills to guide, motivate, and develop a multidisciplinary design team.
* Excellent Communication skills for client interactions, stakeholder alignment, and clear internal collaboration.
* Proven Project Management abilities to oversee timelines, budgets, deliverables, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Hands\-on experience in Product Design or spatial/experience design, ideally within commercial interiors or related domains.
* Background in interior design, architecture, industrial design, or a related field; relevant degree or certification preferred.
* Experience working with design and visualization tools (e.g., CAD, 3D modeling, BIM, VR) and comfort collaborating with technology and AI\-focused teams.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated portfolio showcasing leadership on commercial design projects; familiarity with data\-driven or AI\-assisted design is a plus.

title: Group Manager - Actuarials (Unify, UK Life Insurance)
description:
****Company Description****
 WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

****Job Description****
**Purpose**
* Lead delivery of actuarial transformation initiatives leveraging the Unify platform.
* Act as the primary Business \& Functional SME bridging actuarial stakeholders and workflow development teams.
* Drive process automation, workflow standardisation, governance and business adoption across actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Define and execute the future\-state operating model for actuarial production and transformation.


****Work Experience****
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Life Insurance actuarial functions.
* Minimum 4\+ years in leadership and stakeholder management roles.
* Significant experience across actuarial reporting, valuation, capital modelling, Prophet production, IFRS17 and/or Solvency II processes.
* Experience leading actuarial transformation and automation initiatives.
* Experience working directly with UK Life Insurance clients and stakeholders.


****People Responsibilities****
* Lead and develop a team of actuarial SMEs, business analysts and transformation specialists.
* Mentor team members on actuarial process design, workflow automation and business analysis techniques.
* Drive capability development in Unify, Python, actuarial production processes and governance frameworks.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment and resource allocation.
* Conduct performance reviews and development discussions.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and automation.


****Process Responsibilities \- Business SME Leadership****
* Provide actuarial production expertise and business domain leadership across Unify initiatives.
* Translate actuarial business requirements into detailed functional specifications for workflow developers.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, actuarial teams and development teams.
* Drive solution design decisions ensuring alignment with actuarial processes, controls and governance requirements.
* Provide oversight and challenge throughout the development lifecycle.


****Process Responsibilities \- Unify Transformation \& Workflow Automation****
* Lead design and implementation of Unify workflows supporting actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Drive automation of basis production, model execution, result extraction and reporting activities.
* Support migration of legacy Excel/VBA processes into governed Unify and Python\-based solutions.
* Define reusable workflow frameworks, templates and development standards.
* Support multi\-basis, multi\-risk and multi\-scenario actuarial production solutions.
* Identify automation opportunities and deliver measurable efficiency improvements.


****Process Responsibilities \- Requirements \& Solution Design****
* Lead workshops to gather, document and validate business requirements.
* Develop business process maps, functional specifications and user stories.
* Analyse existing actuarial processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and automation opportunities.
* Design scalable and sustainable future\-state solutions.
* Ensure traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Testing \& Business Readiness****
* Define and execute SIT, UAT and business readiness strategies.
* Coordinate testing activities across actuarial and development teams.
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, controls and timetable expectations.
* Manage defect prioritisation and resolution activities.
* Support operational readiness and transition into production.


****Process Responsibilities \- Governance \& Controls****
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for Unify solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls covering input validation, access management, auditability, version control and result validation.
* Lead governance forums and Go/No\-Go decision processes.
* Maintain solution documentation, audit trails and operational procedures.
* Support internal audit, regulatory and control reviews.


****Process Responsibilities \- Actuarial Domain Expertise****
* Strong understanding of actuarial production processes including valuation, IFRS17, Solvency II, capital modelling and reporting.
* Experience supporting Prophet model execution and downstream reporting processes.
* Understand data flows, assumptions, basis management and results analysis.
* Provide guidance on actuarial process optimisation and target operating models.
* Support strategic transformation programmes involving actuarial and finance functions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Automation \& Innovation****
* Drive adoption of modern technologies including Python, cloud platforms and workflow automation tools.
* Promote standardisation and reusability across actuarial processes.
* Develop dashboards and operational monitoring solutions.
* Support continuous improvement and process modernization initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and automation capabilities.


**Project Leadership**
* Lead large\-scale actuarial transformation and Unify implementation programmes.
* Manage project plans, milestones, risks and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate with actuarial, finance, risk, technology and operations teams.
* Support operating model design and roadmap development.
* Drive successful delivery within agreed timelines and quality standards.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.
* Progressing towards or qualified Fellow of IFoA, SOA, IAI or equivalent actuarial body.
* Fully Qualified Actuary preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong actuarial transformation experience.


****Technical Skills****
* Strong understanding of Life Insurance actuarial processes and reporting frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet ecosystems and actuarial production environments.
* Strong business analysis and process re\-engineering capability.
* Python, SQL and automation expertise.
* Understanding of cloud\-based data and workflow platforms.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.


****Preferred Systems \& Platforms****
* Unify Platform
* Prophet Professional / Prophet Enterprise
* Python Frameworks
* SQL Databases
* Snowflake
* Azure Platform
* Power BI
* Git / Azure DevOps (desirable)


****Soft Skills****
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong facilitation and requirement\-gathering capability.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
* Strong project management and planning skills.
* Strategic thinking and transformation mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Ownership and accountability.
* Strong customer focus.
* Attention to detail and governance mindset.
* Collaborative leadership style.
* Continuous improvement orientation.
* Adaptability and resilience.


****Communication Skills****
* Ability to engage effectively with senior actuarial, finance and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language.
* Strong workshop facilitation and business analysis skills.
* Ability to build consensus and drive decisions across multiple teams.


****Qualifications****
* Graduation/ Masters in Actuarial Science

title: VP, Delivery
description:
**Company Description** 
 Velric is an AI\-powered talent platform that replaces traditional résumés with a proof\-of\-work “Velric Score” built from missions, projects, and challenges that mirror real\-world work. The platform provides a standardized, transparent, and objective way to measure skills, reducing bias and inefficiency in hiring. Individuals use Velric to complete AI\-generated missions, build a verified skills profile, and access opportunities without relying on conventional credentials. Employers benefit from a pre\-validated talent pool, consistent benchmarks for candidate comparison, and the ability to design custom missions that reflect their specific roles. Founded in 2025, Velric is focused on making recruitment fairer, faster, and more effective worldwide.
   

**Role Description** 
 The VP, Delivery is a full\-time remote role responsible for leading end\-to\-end delivery across Velric’s programs, services, and enterprise engagements. This role oversees service delivery operations, ensuring that client implementations, integrations, and ongoing support meet quality, timeline, and performance expectations. The VP, Delivery will manage cross\-functional program and project teams, define delivery frameworks, and standardize best practices for professional services and consulting engagements. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include aligning delivery roadmaps with product strategy, tracking key performance indicators, resolving delivery risks, and continuously improving processes for scalability and customer satisfaction. The role will also collaborate closely with sales, product, and engineering to shape offerings, support pre\-sales scoping, and drive a consistent, high\-quality experience for customers and partners.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to lead complex, multi\-stakeholder initiatives from planning through execution.
* Demonstrated expertise in Service Delivery, including establishing operational frameworks, SLAs, and quality standards for customer\-facing services.
* Experience in Consulting and Professional Services, with the ability to design, deliver, and scale solution\-focused engagements for enterprise clients.
* Proven leadership experience in delivery or operations roles within SaaS, AI, or technology\-driven organizations.
* Ability to build, mentor, and manage distributed teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with comfort using data and KPIs to guide decisions and optimize delivery performance.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with executive\-level client and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent experience in a senior delivery role is a plus.
* Experience scaling delivery operations in a high\-growth or startup environment is highly desirable.

description:
**Title: Manager 2, Statistical Programming**
**Business Unit: Global Clinical Development**
**Job Grade: G11A**
**Location: Remote/Hybrid**
 At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
 **Create your own sunshine** 
 ”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
   

  

**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
 As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Manager 2 will lead one or more Phase I\-IV studies programming activities as per the project strategies.** 
 The incumbent should be able to work independently implementing and executing the programming and project standards to support ongoing clinical studies and requests for study report, regulatory submission, and ad hoc/post hoc analysis. The incumbent will work closely with internal partnering functions, stakeholders, and external functional service providers to ensure all the programming deliverables are delivered in timely manner with high quality. The incumbent will participate in and contribute to development of standard macros, libraries, processes and act as a team player on the various programming tasks.
   

  

**In this role, a typical day might include the following:**
* Lead statistical programming activities for a therapeutic area or compound/indication within multiple studies/projects in various study activities to ensure timely and high\-quality programming deliverables in assigned projects and areas.
* Develop and maintain programming documentations following programming standards and processes. Create CDISC standard SDTM mapping specifications and ADaM specifications.
* Develop and oversee the development of SAS programs for the creation of SDTM and ADaM datasets following CDISC standards and reports (Tables, Listings and Figures).
* Contribute to the development of standard and utility macros, participate in establishing and maintaining statistical programming standards.
* Participate in the CRF annotation, review of SAP, TLFs specifications development and TLFs review.
* Handle all P21 related items and eCRT package including aCRF, define.XML, cSDRG, ADRG and ARM for the regulatory submission to FDA/EMA/PMDA or other agencies.
* Support global regulatory authority submissions following the guidelines (sdTCG, DSC, eCTD etc.) and working closely with partnering functions to address health authority requests.
* Demonstrate company values by demonstrating excellence, competence, collaboration, innovation, respect, ownership, team work and accountability.
* Understand the scope of work, plan and complete the deliveries and timelines with the study team, programming lead and management.
* Performing end\-to\-end programming activities, act as a team player and SME.
* Mentor and Coach new hires and junior programmers.


**This Role May Be For You If Have**
* Strong SAS programming skills in a clinical data environment with excellent analytical skills. Working knowledge of other programming languages such as R, Python etc. is a plus.
* Great knowledge of pharmaceutical clinical development (i.e., understanding of statistical concepts, techniques, and clinical trial principles) and regulatory submissions (NDA, ANDA etc.).
* Extensive working knowledge of using and implementing CDISC standards, Regulatory guidance and TAUG. Prior PTL experience, attention to detail and able to adapt to a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and on global interdisciplinary teams. Good organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills. Positive attitude, team player and growth mindset.
* Problem solving and innovative skills that demonstrate initiative and motivation.
* Demonstrated and applied SAS programming skills. SAS certificates a plus.


**Educational Qualification:** 
**Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Life Science or related discipline.**
**Experience: 4\+ years of programming experience in processing clinical trial data** 
 in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO or health care related industry.
   

  

**Your Success Matters to Us**
 At Sun Pharma, your success and well\-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

 The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employee within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees as assigned to this job. Nothing herein shall preclude the employer from changing these duties from time to time and assigning comparable duties or other duties commensurate with the experience and background of incumbent(s).

title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| London
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology\-enabled, global organization.
   

  

 Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step\-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high\-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology \& AI deployments to end\-to\-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re\-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
   

  

 We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands\-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward\-thinking design.
   

  

**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**
* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication \& engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end\-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on\-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi\-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You’re Good At**
* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement


*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

title: Manager – Exports, Imports & Global Commercial Operations
description:
**Manager – Exports, Imports \& Global Commercial Operations** 




 End\-to\-end ownership of the international order\-to\-delivery cycle
 



  





**Company:** 
 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| www.apacss.com
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 10 – 20 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Chemicals / Specialty Chemicals / Ingredients / International Trading / Merchant Export / Global Sourcing
 



**Function:** 
 Export \& Import Operations / International Logistics / Supply Chain / Commercial Operations
 



 Employment Type: Full Time
 



  





**About the Company** 




 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited is engaged in Global Sourcing, Merchant Export, Custom Manufacturing and Product Development — sourcing products from India and other Asian countries for customers across the USA, Canada, Europe and other international markets. Our business spans chemicals, pharmaceuticals, APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, food and cosmetic ingredients, natural products, polymers, specialty 
 



 chemicals and custom\-manufactured products.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional to take end\-to\-end ownership of international export execution. This is a high\-responsibility position and is not limited to routine export documentation or logistics coordination.
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The incumbent will own the complete order\-to\-delivery cycle:
 



***Customer Order → Supplier Confirmation → Production / Material Readiness → Shipment Planning → Freight Negotiation → Container / Isotank Booking → Export Documentation → Customs → Vessel Departure → Shipment Tracking → Customer Communication → Delivery***




 The principal objective is to ensure that APAC consistently delivers the
 **right product, right quantity and right documentation, at the right freight cost, and within the customer’s committed ETA.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Export Order Ownership** 




 ● Take ownership of every confirmed international customer order.
 



 ● Establish a detailed execution plan from order confirmation to delivery.
 



 ● Track production, material readiness, shipment booking, documentation, customs, vessel departure and ETA.
 



 ● Maintain a live order and shipment tracker.
 



 ● Identify risks well in advance and initiate corrective action.
 



**2\. Customer ETA Management** 




 ● Work towards 100% adherence to committed customer ETA.
 



 ● Monitor vessel schedules, transit times, supplier readiness and shipment milestones.
 



 ● Identify potential delays before they affect the customer.
 



 ● Develop alternative logistics plans where necessary.
 



 ● Maintain clear visibility of customer\-required ETA versus actual / revised ETA.
 



**3\. Supplier / Manufacturer Coordination** 




*A critical part of the position — the incumbent is expected to actively drive supplier readiness rather than wait for supplier updates.* 




 ● Coordinate continuously with suppliers / manufacturers across India and Asia.
 



 ● Confirm production schedules and firm up material readiness dates; follow up on production progress.
 



 ● Coordinate QC / testing and COA availability; confirm packaging and dispatch readiness.
 



 ● Ensure material is ready sufficiently before vessel cut\-offs; coordinate pickup / loading.
 



 ● Identify and escalate supplier delays at an early stage.
 



 ● Ensure suppliers understand customer delivery commitments.
 



 4\. Freight Negotiation \& Cost Optimisation
 



 ● Obtain competitive ocean freight quotations and benchmark rates across major trade lanes.
 



 ● Negotiate with shipping lines, carriers, NVOCCs and logistics providers.
 



 ● Analyse freight components and surcharges; monitor PSS, GRI and other freight changes.
 



 ● Develop direct relationships with shipping\-line commercial teams.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for cost reduction and minimise unnecessary intermediary costs.
 



 ● Maintain freight\-rate records and benchmarks.
 



**5\. Direct Shipping\-Line Booking** 




 Where commercially feasible, develop APAC’s capability to book containers and isotanks directly with shipping lines / carriers, covering:
 



 Direct carrier relationship development • Vessel schedule identification • Rate negotiation • Space booking • Container / isotank availability • Booking confirmation • Equipment release • SI / VGM cut\-off management • Gate\-in coordination • Vessel rollover management • Carrier escalation
 



*Experience with isotank shipments and DG cargo will be an advantage.* 




**6\. Customer Communication \& Shipment Visibility** 




 Maintain proactive communication with international customers, providing timely updates on:
 



 Supplier / material readiness • QC / COA status • Expected dispatch • Container / isotank booking • Vessel details • ETD • Port status • Transshipment • Shipment movement • ETA • Any changes or delays • Shipping documents.
 



*The fundamental principle is: NO SURPRISES FOR THE CUSTOMER.* 




 If an ETA is at risk, the customer must be informed proactively along with the reason, revised timeline and corrective action.
 



**7\. Export Documentation** 




 Coordinate preparation and verification of:
 



 Commercial Invoice • Packing List • Certificate of Origin • COA • SDS / MSDS • DG Declaration • Shipping Instructions • VGM • Shipping Bill • Bill of Lading • Customer\-specific documentation • Product / regulatory documents as applicable
 



*Ensure documentation is accurate and completed before applicable cut\-offs.* 




**8\. Customs \& ICEGATE – In\-House Capability** 




 A key objective for APAC is to develop stronger in\-house control over export customs processes. The incumbent will manage direct preparation and filing of Shipping Bills through the ICEGATE portal, wherever applicable:
 



 ● Prepare Shipping Bill data; verify HSN / ITC classification and export details.
 



 ● File Shipping Bills through ICEGATE and monitor filing status.
 



 ● Resolve validation errors / queries and coordinate with Customs.
 



 ● Monitor the process through clearance / LEO and relevant post\-export stages; maintain proper records.
 



 ● Ensure timely filing so customs formalities do not affect vessel cut\-offs or customer ETA.
 



*APAC will continue to use CHA / C\&F agents primarily for physical customs, port and related activities requiring their involvement, while building greater in\-house capability for documentation, electronic filing, tracking and export execution.* 




**9\. CHA / C\&F / Port Coordination** 




 ● Coordinate with CHA / C\&F agents for customs and port activities; ensure timely customs clearance.
 



 ● Monitor Shipping Bill status and LEO; coordinate examination / inspection where required.
 



 ● Ensure containers reach port within cut\-off; resolve customs / port\-related issues promptly.
 



 ● Monitor DG\-related requirements where applicable.
 



**10\. Container \& Isotank Planning** 




 ● Plan container and isotank requirements in advance; ensure equipment availability before material readiness.
 



 ● Coordinate loading and dispatch; monitor equipment release and return requirements.
 



 ● Coordinate DG and special\-handling requirements; avoid last\-minute equipment shortages.
 



**11\. Shipment Risk \& Exception Management** 




 Proactively manage supplier / production / quality\-release delays, container and isotank shortages, vessel cancellations and rollovers, port congestion, customs issues, documentation errors, DG acceptance issues, transshipment delays and freight increases.
 



*Expected approach: Identify → Analyse → Act → Communicate → Resolve → Close* 




**12\. Management Reporting** 




 Maintain an updated shipment dashboard covering:
 



 Customer • PO • Product • Quantity • Supplier • Production status • Material readiness • QC / COA • Container / isotank • Booking • Vessel • ETD • Customer ETA • Current ETA • ETA variance • Documentation • Customs • Gate\-in • Risk status • Next action
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




 The position will be measured primarily on outcomes:
 



 100% focus on committed customer ETA • Supplier readiness against agreed dates • On\-time shipment execution • Competitive freight rates \& direct carrier bookings • Container / isotank availability • Timely and accurate documentation • Timely ICEGATE Shipping Bill filing • Zero avoidable documentation\-related shipment delays • Proactive customer communication \& early risk identification • Reduction in emergency 
 



 freight and avoidable demurrage / detention • 100% visibility of active shipments
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 10 – 20 years in export operations / international logistics / supply chain • Chemicals, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals or ingredients experience preferred • Strong knowledge of export documentation \& Indian export procedures • Container shipments experience; DG preferred; isotank an advantage • Strong freight negotiation \& direct dealings with shipping lines • Supplier / manufacturer coordination \& 
 



 strong customer communication • ICEGATE / Shipping Bill filing highly desirable; strong Excel / ERP / CRM • Able to manage multiple international shipments simultaneously
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Strong ownership • Commercial orientation • Excellent follow\-through • High sense of urgency • Proactive communication • Strong negotiation skills • Problem\-solving ability • Attention to detail • Works independently • Manages pressure \& multiple priorities
 



  





***The mindset we are looking for: “Once APAC accepts a customer order, I own the execution until the shipment reaches the customer within the committed ETA.”***




 If you want to build and own an international export operation rather than merely process documents, this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Mail your resume to aloksrivastava@apacss.com and odes@apacss.com APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| Gurgaon \| www.apacss.com
