title: Account Manager
description:
ACCOUNT MANAGERAVW Storytellers LLP
 
**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Experience:** 
 4–7 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Storyteller \& Strategist
 


 About AVW Storytellers
 
 AVW Storytellers is a strategic marketing and communications agency that helps brands build stronger narratives through
 **strategy, storytelling, creative communication and audio\-visual content** 
 .
 



 We work with corporates, institutions and ambitious brands to translate business objectives into meaningful communication.
 



 We are looking for an
 **Account Manager** 
 who can sit at the intersection of
 **client relationships, strategy, creative execution and team management** 
 .
 



 This is not a role where you simply take briefs and pass them on.
 



 You will be responsible for understanding what the client needs, getting the best work out of the team, maintaining relationships and ensuring that every assignment moves from
 **brief → thinking → execution → delivery** 
 .
 


 THE ROLE
 
 As an Account Manager, you will be the
 **bridge between the client and the AVW team** 
 .
 



 Your primary responsibility will be to:
 


* Own and nurture client relationships.
* Understand client businesses, objectives and communication requirements.
* Translate client requirements into clear internal briefs.
* Oversee the people working on different accounts and projects.
* Ensure the creative, strategic and production teams deliver the required work.
* Push the team to improve the quality of thinking and execution.
* Coordinate across strategy, creative, design, content, social media and production.
* Track timelines, deliverables and approvals.
* Identify potential issues before they become client problems.
* Ensure clients feel heard, understood and well\-managed.



 In short:
 



**You own the relationship.** 




**You drive the work.** 




**You get the team to deliver.** 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Client Relationship Management
 * Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong, professional and long\-term relationships with corporate clients.
* Understand client businesses, industries, audiences and communication challenges.
* Participate in client meetings and presentations.
* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities.
* Manage expectations, timelines and communication effectively.
* Handle feedback professionally and ensure it reaches the right team members.
* Maintain regular communication with clients and keep them updated on progress.


 2\. Internal Team Management
 * Oversee the teams working on assigned accounts.
* Allocate briefs and coordinate with relevant team members.
* Ensure that briefs are clearly understood before execution begins.
* Follow up with creative, strategy, design, content and production teams.
* Ensure work is delivered within agreed timelines.
* Review work internally before it reaches the client.
* Push teams when work needs greater strategic depth or creative quality.
* Ensure accountability across team members.



**You should be comfortable asking:** 




**“Where is the work?”** 




**“Is this the best thinking we can present?”** 




**“What is the next step?”** 



 3\. Strategy \& Creative Coordination
 
 The Account Manager should be able to understand both
 **strategic thinking and creative execution** 
 .
 



 You will:
 


* Understand brand and business objectives.
* Participate in brainstorming and ideation.
* Help convert business requirements into communication opportunities.
* Work closely with strategists and creative teams.
* Ensure that creative outputs remain aligned with the strategic objective.
* Understand campaigns, brand narratives, content, films, social media and communication assets.
* Present and explain the thinking behind the work to clients.



 You do
 **not necessarily have to be the strongest copywriter or designer** 
 , but you must have enough understanding of strategy and creative to recognise good work and drive the team towards it.
 


 4\. Project \& Delivery Management
 * Maintain project timelines and trackers.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.
* Follow up on dependencies and approvals.
* Ensure deliverables are completed as committed.
* Flag delays, bottlenecks and risks early.
* Coordinate with production partners/vendors wherever required.
* Ensure final deliverables meet AVW's quality standards.


 5\. Social Media — Added Advantage
 
 Experience in social media will be a strong advantage.
 



 The ideal candidate should understand:
 


* Social media strategy
* Content calendars
* Platform\-specific content
* LinkedIn and Instagram communication
* Content performance
* Paid social basics
* Campaign planning
* Community/content management



 You don't necessarily need to be a hands\-on social media specialist, but you should be able to
 **understand, evaluate and manage social media work** 
 .
 


 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


 Corporate\-Client Experienced
 
 You should have experience working with
 **corporate clients, brands or established organisations** 
 , preferably in an agency, marketing, advertising, communications, branding, digital or consulting environment.
 



 You should be comfortable dealing with:
 


* Senior stakeholders
* Marketing teams
* Corporate communication teams
* Brand teams
* CXOs/business heads
* Multiple stakeholders and approval layers


 A Strong People Manager
 
 You should know how to get work done through people.
 



 You must be comfortable coordinating with different personalities, skill sets and functions while keeping everyone accountable.
 


 Strategic \+ Creative
 
 You should be able to understand:
 



**Business Problem → Communication Problem → Strategic Thought → Creative Solution → Execution** 




 You should not look at work only from a project\-management perspective.
 



 You should care about the
 **quality of the thinking and the final output** 
 .
 


 Proactive
 
 We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for instructions for every next step.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Anticipate requirements.
* Follow up without being asked.
* Identify gaps.
* Suggest solutions.
* Escalate issues at the right time.
* Keep projects moving.


 A Strong Communicator
 
 Excellent verbal and written communication is essential.
 



 You should be able to communicate confidently with both a corporate client and an internal creative team.
 


 MUST\-HAVE SKILLS
 * 4–7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing corporate/enterprise clients.
* Strong client relationship management.
* Strong project and account management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to coordinate creative and strategic teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Ability to create clear briefs and follow through on execution.
* Strong follow\-up and ownership.
* Good understanding of marketing and communication.
* Ability to work under deadlines.
* Strong presentation and meeting skills.


 GOOD TO HAVE
 * Social media experience.
* Advertising/creative agency experience.
* Brand strategy experience.
* Content marketing experience.
* Digital marketing exposure.
* Experience working with senior corporate stakeholders.
* Experience in B2B communication.
* Experience with audio\-visual/film projects.


 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 



**1\. Own client relationships** 




 Clients know they can rely on you.
 



**2\. Understand the business** 




 You understand what the client is trying to achieve—not just what they have asked for.
 



**3\. Drive the team** 




 Work moves without the leadership having to chase every task.
 



**4\. Improve the quality of output** 




 You are able to identify when something is not good enough and get the team to improve it.
 



**5\. Maintain delivery discipline** 




 Timelines, approvals and deliverables are managed proactively.
 



**6\. Create trust** 




 Both clients and internal teams see you as someone who can get things done.
 


 THE AVW MINDSET
 
 At AVW Storytellers, we don't believe an Account Manager is simply a
 **messenger between the client and the team** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can
 **think, communicate, coordinate and deliver** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand the business problem, come back to the team, articulate what needs to be solved, drive the thinking and make sure the final work goes back to the client at the highest possible standard.
 


 If you are someone who enjoys owning relationships, solving problems, managing people and making good work happen — this role is for you.

title: SPM/Project Lead - Fundraising
description:
**SPM/Project Lead, Fundraising**
**Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives**
**Central Square Foundation**
**Location:** 
 New Delhi
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Senior Project Lead, Fundraising
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\-8 years
   

  

**About Central Square Foundation**
 Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is an education\-focused nonprofit working to ensure quality education for every child in India through system\-led reform. CSF partners with the government to design, implement and scale evidence\-based initiatives across its five priorities: Foundational Literacy and Numeracy, ensuring every child attains foundational literacy and numeracy skills; Early Childhood Education, building strong early learning foundations that prepare every child to succeed from their very first day of school; School Governance, strengthening school accountability and parent engagement for improving school quality; EdTech \& AI, leveraging technology to improve teaching and learning at scale; and High Potential Students, creating pathways for high potential students from underserved backgrounds to realize their potential and become leaders of tomorrow. CSF works across 13 states and one Union Territory.
   

  

**About Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives**
 The Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives (PSI) team works across CSF to build and nurture strategic partnerships and initiatives that advance the organisation's mission. The Fundraising team, a core part of PSI, is responsible for mobilising the resources and building the partnerships that enable CSF to pursue its priorities. This includes developing a strong and diversified fundraising pipeline, building and deepening donor relationships, translating CSF's work into compelling funding propositions, supporting effective donor stewardship, and strengthening the systems and processes that enable high\-quality and agile resource mobilisation. The team works closely with colleagues across CSF, including programme teams, leadership, Finance, Communications and RMEAL, as well as a wide range of donors, government stakeholders, philanthropic organisations and partners across the education and impact ecosystem.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to help build and grow CSF’s fundraising efforts, bringing strong relationship\-building, strategic thinking and execution capabilities to the Fundraising team within PSI across both donor cultivation and relationship management.
   

  

 The Project Lead, Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives (Fundraising) will play a key role in advancing CSF’s fundraising efforts and building the institutional resources needed to support its mission.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands\-on role spanning the full fundraising lifecycle, from prospect research and pipeline development through outreach, donor cultivation, proposal development, engagement, stewardship and renewals, across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations and HNIs/UHNIs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Project Lead, PSI, the role combines independent ownership with close collaboration, working closely with the Senior Project Lead and relevant colleagues across the fundraising function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Fundraising Pipeline Building
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective donors across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations, HNIs/UHNIs and other funding sources.
* Conduct prospect research and landscape analysis to identify and qualify prospective funders, assessing their priorities, interests, funding potential, decision\-making processes and potential areas of alignment with CSF.
* Identify relevant entry points for qualified prospects and develop tailored approaches for initiating and deepening conversations.
* Manage assigned opportunities through the fundraising funnel, from prospect identification and qualification through outreach, cultivation, proposal development and closure.
* Identify opportunities to leverage CSF's existing relationships and networks to strengthen connections with prospective funders and broaden the fundraising pipeline.
* Stay abreast of developments across philanthropy, CSR and the wider social\-impact ecosystem to identify emerging funding opportunities.
* Donor Cultivation
* Develop and advance relationships with prospective funders, identifying relevant opportunities and approaches to build interest in CSF and progress potential funding relationships.
* Develop and execute thoughtful cultivation plans for priority prospects, identifying relevant opportunities and touchpoints to build familiarity, trust and interest in CSF’s work.
* Contribute to converting prospective donors into long\-term CSF partners, including by identifying opportunities for multi\-year, expanded or repeat engagement.
* Donor Engagement, Management \& Stewardship
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing donors, serving as a responsive, reliable and trusted point of contact and ensuring a consistently high standard of donor servicing.
* Develop a strong understanding of each donor’s priorities, interests, partnership history, key stakeholders, decision\-making processes, hot buttons and opportunities for deeper engagement.
* Develop and implement thoughtful engagement plans for existing donors, tailored to the relationship, donor interests and stage of engagement, with a focus on deepening relationships, strengthening retention and creating opportunities for continued or expanded support.
* Ensure timely, high\-quality and tailored donor communication, including updates, reports, follow\-ups and other relevant touchpoints, while anticipating donor needs and proactively addressing requests or concerns.
* Explore creative and differentiated ways to deepen donor relationships beyond formal reporting requirements and routine cadences, including through tailored impact updates, curated content, immersion experiences and other relevant touchpoints.
* Support and as required, manage donor meetings and engagements, ensuring strong preparation, follow\-through and clear internal ownership of commitments.
* Support efforts to develop existing donors into long\-term advocates, champions and connectors for CSF, creating opportunities for them to deepen their association with CSF’s mission.
* Maintain strong donor relationship intelligence, ensuring that key interactions, insights, decisions and next steps are systematically captured and appropriately shared internally to enable a common and up\-to\-date understanding of donor relationships.
* Fundraising narratives and collateral
* Develop high\-quality, tailored concept notes, proposals, and other funding applications, translating CSF's priorities, evidence and systems\-change approach into compelling propositions.
* Work closely with programme, RMEAL, Communications and other relevant teams to understand and distil CSF's work, evidence, outcomes and insights into clear, persuasive and fundable narratives
* Contribute to the development of broader fundraising collateral, including investment cases, one\-pagers, primers, prospect briefs, presentations, leveraging existing evidence and organisational knowledge and tailoring them to different donor archetypes.
* Build and contribute to reusable fundraising resources, including evidence banks, messaging, case studies, narrative frameworks, proposal assets and other knowledge resources that strengthen the team's effectiveness, consistency and ability to respond quickly to opportunities.
* Fundraising Process \& Systems
* Contribute to strengthening discipline across key fundraising processes and systems, ensuring that opportunities, actions, follow\-ups, deadlines and next steps are consistently tracked and progressed.
* Maintain and continuously strengthen the Donor Management Dashboard as a central source of information on existing donor relationships, capturing key details including donor commitments, reporting timelines, engagement plans, actions and next steps.
* Maintain the fundraising CRM and pipeline trackers, ensuring prospect and opportunity information is accurate and up to date, with clear visibility on movement through the fundraising funnel, ownership and next steps.
* Identify and implement improvements to fundraising processes, including templates, trackers, and knowledge resources, to improve efficiency, consistency, coordination and institutional memory across the fundraising function.
* Fundraising Governance \& Leadership Support
* Support development of fundraising dashboards, pipeline snapshots, funding gap analyses and other leadership\-ready views for internal reviews and discussions, translating fundraising information into clear insights for decision\-making.
* Support Board and senior leadership engagement on fundraising, including preparing data\-driven presentations, fundraising updates and briefing materials, and ensuring that agreed actions and follow\-ups are tracked through to completion.
* Internal Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships across CSF and work effectively with colleagues across functions to align on fundraising priorities, secure timely inputs, resolve bottlenecks and keep fundraising opportunities and donor commitments moving forward.
* Proactively coordinate across programme, RMEAL, Finance, Communications, leadership and other relevant teams, bringing together the right inputs and stakeholders to deliver high\-quality fundraising and donor engagement requirements.
* External Representation \& Ecosystem Engagement
* Represent CSF at relevant donor forums, conferences, sector convenings and meetings, as appropriate, helping strengthen CSF's visibility and positioning within the philanthropic and CSR ecosystem.
* Build and nurture relationships with relevant players across the philanthropic and social\-impact ecosystem, including peer organisations, intermediary platforms, consultants, government stakeholders and other ecosystem partners.
* Identify relevant platforms, networks, events and convenings that can create opportunities for learning and partnerships.


**What We're Looking For**
**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 5\-8 years of relevant professional experience in fundraising and donor management within the development sector, with experience working with CSR, foundations, HNIs/UHNIs or other philanthropic/institutional funders.
* Demonstrated experience across multiple aspects of the fundraising lifecycle, including prospect research, donor cultivation, proposal development, partnership management, stewardship and renewals.
* Master’s degree in business, public policy, economics, development studies, or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop sharp compelling proposals, presentations, briefs and donor communications.
* Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesise information and translate it into actionable fundraising insights.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, with the ability to work confidently with fundraising data, pipeline trackers and dashboards.
* Experience with CRM and donor management systems is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with senior leadership on fundraising priorities and engagements.


**Desired Qualities**
* High ownership: You take responsibility for moving work forward, anticipate what is needed and close loops without needing constant direction.
* Strong relationship builder: You build trust with donors and colleagues, listen well and invest in relationships over time.
* Collaborative and persistent: You work effectively across a large organisation, build productive working relationships and are comfortable following through with multiple stakeholders to get things done.
* Proactive and resourceful: You spot opportunities, find solutions and bring structure and momentum to complex or evolving pieces of work.
* Clear thinker and communicator: You move comfortably between research and analysis, writing and storytelling, presentations and external conversations, adapting your approach to different audiences.
* Curious and creative: You are keen to understand CSF’s work and the evolving philanthropic landscape, and think creatively about how to position our work and engage donors in relevant and distinctive ways.
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity: You thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment, respond well to changing priorities and are able to navigate ambiguity while maintaining focus and momentum.

title: Team Lead , Credentialing
description:
**About CertifyOS**
 CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.
   

  

 Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.
   

  

 Our API\-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.
   

  

 Our vision is simple:
 **One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.**
 We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high\-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 As Credentialing Team Lead, you will lead a production\-focused pod of Operations Analysts and Credentialing Specialists, owning the day\-to\-day execution of credentialing operations for your pod's clients. You will be responsible for driving team performance, ensuring compliance and quality, and keeping your pod's work aligned with company\-wide objectives. This role requires a balance of hands\-on operational ownership, direct people leadership, and proactive problem\-solving to keep your pod scaling effectively.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role that owns outcomes for a subset of clients and reports into the Credentialing Manager.
   

  

 This is a fully remote role aligned to EST hours.
   

  

**What You’ll Do** 
 :
   

  

***Production Management \& Business Continuity***
* Own core operational metrics for your pod \-\- speed, quality, and efficiency \-\- ensuring SLAs are consistently met and quality remains high.
* Monitor turnaround times and quality metrics daily and weekly; drive corrective actions to maintain compliance and efficiency.
* Identify process gaps, document SOPs, and lead internal training to close them.
* Manage escalations for your pod, partnering with cross\-functional teams to resolve issues quickly and prevent repeat problems.
* Oversee ongoing monitoring and management of credentialing expirables within your pod.
* Support workload balancing and capacity planning as volume grows, flagging risks to your manager early.


***Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Communication***
* Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations, streamline workflows, and improve operational outcomes.
* Communicate performance insights upward to your manager, downward to your team, and laterally to peer Team Leads to keep everyone aligned.
* Prepare ad hoc reports and operational analyses to support decision\-making.
* Support direct client engagement where needed, representing your pod's work accurately and professionally.


***Team Leadership \& Performance Management***
* Lead and manage a pod of Credentialing Specialists and Operations Analysts to ensure timely and accurate file processing.
* Coach, mentor, and train team members to strengthen credentialing knowledge and regulatory compliance.
* Oversee workflows to ensure adherence to NCQA standards, state guidelines, and client requirements.
* Conduct daily standups and weekly performance reviews to track throughput, quality, and key metrics.
* Facilitate performance reviews and deliver performance conversations directly to your team members.
* Support onboarding of new hires, provide guidance during training, and participate in hiring for your pod.
* Identify attrition risks on your team and proactively raise retention concerns to your manager.
* Foster a strong team culture, driving collaboration, engagement, and a high\-performance mindset within your pod.


**What You’ll Need:**
* 5\+ years of professional US\-healthtech \+ Credentialing experience, including 2\+ years managing a team.
* Proven ability to lead a team of 5\+ in a production\-driven environment.
* Experience working with cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong client engagement and stakeholder management experience.
* A metrics\-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance hands\-on execution with long\-term operational strategy.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage daily performance metrics and drive accountability.
* Knowledge of credentialing processes, provider data management, and healthcare compliance (preferred).


**Nice to Have:**
* 1–2 years of experience in credentialing, provider enrollment, or healthcare operations.
* Knowledge of NCQA guidelines and state/federal credentialing regulations.
* Skills in SQL, Excel Macros, or related analytical tools.


**Benefits Of Working At Certify**
* At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.
* Your well\-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US\-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.


 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.
   

  

 We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

title: Store Development & Project Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Future World India is looking for a hands\-on Store Development \& Projects Manager to manage the development and execution of our retail stores across India.
 



  





 The person will be responsible for taking a store project from initial site assessment and store brief through civil work, interiors, vendor coordination and final handover, ensuring that the store is completed on time, within budget and as per the required design and quality standards.
 



  





 We are looking for someone with strong practical knowledge of construction and interiors. The candidate does not necessarily need to be a qualified architect or a highly technical designer. Hands\-on execution experience is a must.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be someone who can visit a site, understand what needs to be done, prepare a practical execution plan, coordinate contractors and vendors, solve problems on\-site and deliver a
 **fully completed, opening\-ready retail store** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Store Brief \& Site Assessment** 



* Visit prospective store locations and assess the site from a construction and execution perspective.
* Prepare detailed
 **store development briefs** 
 covering civil, interiors, electrical, HVAC, lighting, signage, storage, back\-office and other requirements.
* Understand business and operational requirements and translate them into practical store requirements.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers and consultants wherever required.
* Review proposed layouts and identify practical execution issues before work begins.



  





**2\. Civil \& Interior Execution** 




 Take ownership of all civil and interior execution activities, including:
 


* Flooring
* False ceilings
* Walls and partitions
* Civil modifications
* Painting and finishes
* Carpentry and furniture
* Glass work
* Electrical work
* Lighting
* HVAC
* Plumbing
* Fire\-safety\-related works
* Signage and façade
* Fixtures and other retail fit\-outs



 The candidate should be able to
 **understand drawings and specifications and translate them into actual site execution.** 




  





**3\. Contractor \& Vendor Management** 



* Identify and coordinate civil contractors, interior contractors and specialist vendors.
* Obtain and compare quotations.
* Prepare / review
 **BOQs, measurements and cost estimates** 
 .
* Negotiate with contractors and vendors.
* Allocate work and monitor contractor performance.
* Ensure contractors maintain agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Develop a reliable vendor/contractor network across key cities.



  





**4\. Project Management** 



* Manage projects from
 **site handover to store opening** 
 .
* Prepare project timelines and execution schedules.
* Monitor daily/weekly progress.
* Coordinate multiple contractors and agencies working simultaneously.
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action.
* Escalate major issues and provide practical solutions.
* Maintain project documentation, estimates, BOQs, quotations and completion records.
* Ensure projects are completed within the approved budget.



  





**5\. Cost Control** 



* Prepare preliminary project cost estimates.
* Track project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising quality.
* Check contractor bills and measurements.
* Control variations, additional works and project overruns.
* Ensure commercial terms agreed with contractors are adhered to.



  





**6\. Quality Control** 



* Conduct regular site inspections.
* Check workmanship, materials, dimensions and finishes.
* Ensure execution matches approved drawings/design standards.
* Identify defects and coordinate corrective action.
* Prepare snag lists and ensure timely closure.
* Conduct final quality checks before store handover.



  





**7\. Store Opening \& Handover** 



* Coordinate with internal teams including Retail Operations, IT, Security, Visual Merchandising and other stakeholders.
* Ensure all civil/interior works are completed before the committed opening date.
* Coordinate final testing and commissioning wherever required.
* Ensure the store is
 **100% ready for merchandising and operations** 
 .
* Complete project handover and close all pending issues.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on project execution professional** 
 , rather than someone whose experience is limited to preparing drawings.
 



 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have strong practical knowledge of
 **civil construction and commercial interiors** 
 .
* Have experience executing
 **retail stores, showrooms, offices, restaurants, commercial spaces or similar projects** 
 .
* Be comfortable spending significant time at project sites.
* Understand architectural/interior drawings and be able to coordinate their execution.
* Have good knowledge of civil, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, flooring, ceiling, lighting and finishing works.
* Understand BOQs, measurements, estimates and contractor bills.
* Have strong contractor and vendor management skills.
* Be a good negotiator.
* Be able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Be willing to travel extensively for store projects.
* Have the ability to independently resolve day\-to\-day site issues.



  





**Qualification** 




 A formal architecture degree is
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 Candidates with the following backgrounds may be considered:
 


* Diploma / Degree in Civil Engineering
* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Construction Management
* Diploma in Civil / Interior\-related fields
* Other relevant qualifications with strong practical experience



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:
 


* Retail store development
* Premium retail
* Electronics / mobile / technology retail
* Fashion or lifestyle retail
* Showrooms
* Shopping malls
* Commercial interiors
* Multi\-location retail projects



 Experience in executing
 **multiple stores across different cities** 
 will be a strong advantage.
 



  





**Key Skills** 




**Essential:** 



* Civil construction
* Retail/interior fit\-outs
* Contractor management
* Vendor management
* BOQ \& estimation
* Site supervision
* Project scheduling
* Cost control
* Quality control
* Drawing interpretation
* Problem solving



**Desirable:** 



* AutoCAD – basic/intermediate
* MS Excel
* Project planning tools
* MEP knowledge
* Mall/landlord coordination
* Knowledge of retail design standards



  





  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




 The candidate will be responsible for:
 


1. **On\-time completion of stores**
2. Project cost within approved budget
3. Quality of civil and interior execution
4. Reduction in rework and project delays
5. Effective contractor/vendor management
6. Timely resolution of site issues
7. Compliance with approved store design standards
8. Store readiness before committed opening date



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who can
 **own the entire execution process** 
 .
 



 Someone who can walk into an empty retail space and say:
 



**“This is what needs to be done, this is how we will execute it, these are the contractors/vendors required, this is the estimated cost, this is the timeline, and I will ensure the store is ready for opening on time.”** 




 We value
 **practical knowledge, ownership, execution capability and problem\-solving ability** 
 more than titles or academic qualifications.
 



**Important Note** 




**This is not a pure architecture/design position.** 




 The role is primarily focused on
 **store development, civil \& interior execution, contractor management and project delivery.**

title: Processing and Project Specialist
description:
**Who are we?** 








 Howden is a collective \- a group of talented and passionate people all around the world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mind\-set, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 26,000 employees spanning over 100 countries.
 







 People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It's what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head\-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities \- work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering \- you'll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.
 







**Working at Howden Re** 








 At Howden Re, we're on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.
 







 As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one\-size\-fits\-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. Our team is empowered to drive progress, creating opportunities for career and personal development, unlocking new value for clients, fostering long\-term partnerships, and using the collective power of Howden to change how the world sees risk and insurance.
 



 When you join Howden Re, you become part of a vibrant and entrepreneurial workplace culture that prioritises collaboration, ownership, and shared success. Here, your contributions will directly impact our mission to be the global partner of choice in reinsurance and strategic advisory.
 







 Be a part of Howden Re's exciting journey. Together, we are shaping the future of reinsurance.
 











**The Role** 








 This role sits within the Operations and Processing functions, supporting end\-to\-end post\-placement activities, ad hoc operational projects, and system adoption across key platforms including counterparties management systems and broking platforms.
 







 This position plays a critical role in ensuring operational continuity, strengthening processing capability, and driving consistency across regions during ongoing platform and operating model evolution.
   





 This role is well suited to someone with strong systems aptitude and a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach, who is comfortable acting as a hands\-on subject matter expert and supporting teams across multiple regions.
 











**What will you be doing?** 







* Deliver end\-to\-end processing across facultative, treaty and some binder business, from receipt through to payment with limited claims exposure.
* Provide Global XB training and support, including hands\-on guidance, troubleshooting and query resolution.
* Participate in system testing and validation, including new fields, document types and workflows.
* Deliver ad hoc operational and project support, including issue resolution and pragmatic workarounds.
* Support brokerage accrual processes where required.







**Development \& future responsibilities** 







* Support Open Twins rollout, leveraging prior experience of broking platform roll\-outs to facilitate adoption.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Open Twins, supporting training and user queries.
* Assist with security reviews and counterparties onboarding for new locations and entities where required.
* Provide targeted processing support across regions where bottlenecks arise, including one\-to\-one support and process optimisation.







**Key capabilities:** 







* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end post\-placement processes.
* Strong systems aptitude, ideally with exposure to Global XB and Open Twins broking platforms, risk processing workflows or similar platforms.
* Confidence acting as a hands\-on subject matter expert, providing training and troubleshooting support.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to support teams across multiple regions and functions.
* A problem\-solving mindset, with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones, ensuring responsiveness and continuity of operations.











**What do we offer in return?** 








 A career that you define.
 







 Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society's greatest challenges.
 



 And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work \- and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.
 



 Diversity and Inclusion
 







 At Howden we value diversity \- there is no one Howden 'personality type'. Instead, we're looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
 






* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond







 We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect \- regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.
 







**Reasonable adjustments** 








 We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.
 







 If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it's the right fit for you, send us your application \- if your profile fits the role's criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
 



 \*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
 



 Our sustainability promise
 







 We're on a life\-long journey to become an ever\-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.
